description: Run a citation tracker now. Every prompt x engine x sample counts as one check. A run needs all of its checks up front (the month's remaining allowance plus any top-up balance); if that is short the run is refused and nothing is spent. A check whose engine returned an error is not counted. A run that takes over 45 seconds returns {run_id, status: "running", poll} instead of the summary; it keeps running, so call get_citation_run with that run_id until status is completed.
name: run_citation_tracker
